textPlacement.assessment: Pass for the exact r06 opening, both topic rows and full entry. “A conversation with your baby” names the subject clearly and distinguishes this entry in the current title-only topic scan. The invitation, standalone summary and cue keep listening and responding to sounds, smiles and gestures warm and reciprocal. The full entry allows vocal play without demanding a word, a particular sound or a completed turn. Optional signs stay alongside speech, with the differing source age labels visible in the full age context and interest guiding participation. “Listen,” “Start by noticing” and “Try this together” fit the invitation; they add no test, deadline or parent comparison. The title change resolves the prior issue without weakening the underlying conversational meaning.
